summary: ON Semiconductor priced $1.3B of 0% convertible senior notes due 2031 in a private Rule 144A offering. Notes are convertible at ~52.5% premium above the $105.77 closing price. Issuer granted initial purchasers a 13-day option for an additional $200M. Proceeds net ~$1,276.4M (or ~$1,472.9M with option) will partly fund ~$61.2M for convertible hedge transactions cost, partially offset by warrant sale proceeds, and ~$331.9M to repurchase ~3.1M shares. The offering closes May 11, 2026. The transaction combines debt capital-raising with a concurrent share repurchase, effectively a liability management and capital return event. While this involves a convertible note issuance, the explicit use of proceeds for share buybacks and hedge/warrant overlay positions it as a capital return structure rather than a routine financing.
